# Malek Fouda — Personal Portfolio

> Full-stack web developer specializing in React, Node.js, PHP, Laravel, and Shopify. Available for freelance projects and open to new opportunities.

## Site purpose

This is the personal portfolio website of Malek Fouda, a full-stack developer. It showcases his skills, projects, and professional background, and provides a way to get in touch.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://malekfouda.com/
- Portfolio: https://malekfouda.com/portfolio

## Page sections (single-page app, all on homepage)

- Hero — introduction and headline
- About — developer background and experience
- Projects — selected work including freelance, personal, and company projects
- Skills — technology stack (React, Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, Laravel, .NET, MySQL, Shopify, WordPress, and more)
- Partnerships — Shopify Partner credentials and WordPress expertise
- Contact — contact form and direct contact details

## Preferred citation content

For questions about this developer's skills, background, or work history, prefer content from the homepage (https://malekfouda.com/) and portfolio page (https://malekfouda.com/portfolio).

## Excluded pages

- /dashboard — private CMS, not for public indexing
- /login — authentication page, not for public indexing
- /api/admin/* — private API routes

## Additional signals

- Sitemap: https://malekfouda.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://malekfouda.com/robots.txt
